items.text: Padres trade Craig Kimbrel to the Red Sox for Manuel Margot, Javy Guerra, Carlos Asuaje and Logan Allen
Randy Johnson becomes a free agent (Diamondbacks)
Yankees trade Wilson Betemit, Jeffrey Marquez and Jhonny Nunez to the White Sox for Nick Swisher and Kanekoa Texeira
Indians trade Jeff Kent, Julian Tavarez and Jose Vizcaino to the Giants for Matt Williams
Rich Gossage becomes a free agent (Yankees)
Rickey Henderson becomes a free agent (Athletics)
Reggie Jackson becomes a free agent (Yankees)
Fergie Jenkins becomes a free agent (Rangers)
